title: The way to select attributes for faceting or attributes to display is not clear
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

I recently noticed that --attributes-for-faceting requires the customer to select an item by tapping the space bar… but if I navigated to an attribute and clicked Enter, it’ll create the app without adding the facet to the InstantSearch app. 

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

1. Open your terminal
2. Run `create-instantsearch-app`
3. Navigate towards `--attributes-for-faceting` or `--attributes-to-display`
4. Notice that if the customer hovers over an item and clicks the _Enter_ or _Return_ key on their keyboard, it'll complete the step without selecting an item. It's not directly evident the customer must select _Space_ to make their multi-selection.

### Live reproduction

not applicable

### 💭 Expected behavior

It should be more clear how to make a selection. Customer should explicitly select "none" instead of treating an _Enter_ without anything selected as "none". Ideally, it would be directly evident how to select things.

### Package version

Latest version of react
